requirement_text: Static binary for x86_64 Linux (RHEL) and Windows (Win10/Win11)
target_value: Binary runs on RHEL 8/9 and Win10/Win11 without runtime deps
notes: Rust musl target for Linux; MSVC for Windows. Must be signable. Goose fork baseline.

requirement_text: Standalone installer packaging for closed network transfer
target_value: Installer works offline on RHEL and Windows
notes: RPM/DEB for Linux; MSI/EXE for Windows. No network calls during install. Must pass STIG review.

requirement_text: Binary signing and SBOM generation
target_value: Binary is code-signed with SBOM attached
notes: GPG/Authenticode signing. CycloneDX SBOM. Reproducible builds via Cargo.

requirement_text: Single-pane chat layout with status line and input
target_value: TUI renders chat log + status line + input
notes: ratatui with Cassowary layout. Status line (1 row top). Scrolling chat log (fill). Multi-line input (bottom). No persistent sidebar.

requirement_text: Streaming markdown rendering with syntax highlighting
target_value: Markdown streams at 30+ FPS without flicker
notes: tui-markdown + pulldown-cmark + syntect. Rate-limit renders at 30 FPS. Sticky scroll via tui-scrollview.

requirement_text: Inline unified diff rendering for proposed file changes
target_value: Diffs render with red/green coloring and collapse
notes: Collapsed by default showing hunk summary. Expandable. Addresses Claude Code verbosity complaint.

requirement_text: Multi-line input with vim mode and history
target_value: Input supports vim keybindings and command history
notes: ratatui-textarea with vim mode. Up/Down for history. Shift+Enter for newline.

requirement_text: Inline tool call blocks with spinner and collapse
target_value: Tool calls render as compact inline blocks
notes: Spinner during execution. Collapse to one-liner on completion. Expandable for detail.

requirement_text: Thinking animation with contextual verbs
target_value: Spinner shows what the agent is doing
notes: Rotating verbs: Reading... Analyzing... Planning... Shows current tool name when executing.

requirement_text: Agentic REA loop with function calling and tool use
target_value: Agent completes multi-step tasks autonomously
notes: Fork Goose agentic loop. Read-Evaluate-Act cycle. Terminates on prompt resolution or user interrupt.

requirement_text: Built-in tool set: read_file write_file run_command list_dir grep
target_value: All tools execute correctly and return structured results
notes: Safe tools (read) auto-execute. Mutating tools (write/exec) require HITL. Tool responses injected into conversation history.

requirement_text: ToolShim for local models without native function calling
target_value: Local models can execute tool calls via structured prompting
notes: Goose ToolShim. Critical for air-gapped SIPR with Ollama/vLLM where models lack native tool_use.

requirement_text: Sub-agent spawning for parallel read-only tasks
target_value: Sub-agents complete read-only research tasks
notes: Task agent with restricted tool set (read-only). Costs roll up to parent session.

requirement_text: HITL gate blocks all state-mutating tool calls
target_value: No file write or command execution without explicit user approval
notes: Inline approval dialog: [Y] Approve [N] Deny [E] Edit [S] Skip. Blocks event loop until response. Logs decision to audit ledger.

requirement_text: Configurable permission rules with graduated trust
target_value: Users can configure allow/deny rules per tool and path pattern
notes: Session-persistent and config-persistent grants. Mode cycling: Ask / AcceptEdits / FullAuto. No --yolo in production.

requirement_text: Multi-provider LLM abstraction with Vertex AI support
target_value: Agent sends prompts to Vertex AI and receives streaming responses
notes: Provider trait with factory pattern. Vertex AI via google-genai crate. Streaming via tokio channels.

requirement_text: AWS Bedrock provider for Claude and Nova models
target_value: Agent sends prompts to Bedrock GovCloud endpoints
notes: AWS SDK auth chain. GovCloud region support. Note: Opus 4.6 not yet in GovCloud.

requirement_text: Azure OpenAI provider for GPT-5.4 models
target_value: Agent sends prompts to Azure Government OpenAI endpoints
notes: Azure OpenAI client. Entra ID or API key auth. Azure Gov region support.

requirement_text: Local model provider via OpenAI-compatible API
target_value: Agent works with Ollama/vLLM on air-gapped networks
notes: LOCAL_ENDPOINT env var. OpenAI-compatible API. Zero network egress. Must work fully offline.

requirement_text: Embedded Pulumi IaC for GCP Assured Workloads (IL4/IL5)
target_value: aegis init provisions compliant GCP boundary
notes: Assured Workloads folder (20% premium). Cloud KMS CMEK. VPC-SC perimeter. Audit log bucket. Vertex AI endpoint pinning. US regions only.

requirement_text: Embedded Pulumi IaC for AWS GovCloud
target_value: aegis init provisions compliant AWS GovCloud boundary
notes: GovCloud account. AWS KMS. VPC + PrivateLink. CloudTrail + S3. Bedrock endpoint.

requirement_text: Embedded Pulumi IaC for Azure Government
target_value: aegis init provisions compliant Azure Gov boundary
notes: Azure Gov subscription. Key Vault. VNet + Private Endpoint. Monitor + Storage. Azure OpenAI endpoint.

requirement_text: aegis init state machine with three deployment modes
target_value: aegis init completes and writes valid config
notes: State machine: Environment Probe -> Mode Selection -> Credential Negotiation -> Infrastructure Binding -> Config Commit. Modes: Self-Service BYOC / Enterprise BYOC / Managed SaaS.

requirement_text: Configuration artifact at ~/.aegis/config.yaml with 0600 perms
target_value: Config file exists with correct permissions and no secrets
notes: Contains: mode / cloud / region / endpoint / kms_key_id / audit_bucket. No tokens or secrets. POSIX 600.

requirement_text: Air-gapped initialization without cloud provisioning
target_value: aegis init --local configures for local-only operation
notes: No network calls. Points to LOCAL_ENDPOINT. No Pulumi. Config indicates mode: local. For SIPR deployment.

requirement_text: .aegisignore context filtering with mandatory blocklist
target_value: Blocked files are never read into agent context
notes: Inherits .gitignore. Mandatory blocklist: .env / *.pem / ~/.aws/credentials / *.key / *.pfx. Agent receives permission denied error on blocked paths.

requirement_text: TLS 1.3 with FIPS 140-2 validated cryptography for cloud transport
target_value: All LLM API calls use FIPS-compliant TLS 1.3
notes: rustls with FIPS provider or OpenSSL FIPS module. Certificate validation. No TLS downgrade.

requirement_text: OS-level sandboxing for tool execution
target_value: Shell commands execute in sandboxed environment
notes: bubblewrap (Linux) / seatbelt (macOS). Restrict filesystem access. Restrict network. Ban dangerous commands. From Goose baseline.

requirement_text: Immutable local audit ledger at ~/.aegis/logs/*.jsonl
target_value: All agent actions logged with metadata only
notes: JSON Lines format. Append-only. Auto-rotating. Logged: session start/stop / user identity / file paths read / token counts / HITL approvals. NOT logged: prompts / file contents / AI responses / stdout.

requirement_text: Cloud audit logs via provider-native logging
target_value: Cloud-side API access is logged in CMEK-encrypted storage
notes: GCP Cloud Audit Logs / AWS CloudTrail / Azure Monitor. Proves authorized IAM identity accessed model from authorized IP.

requirement_text: Audit entries link to RTMX requirement IDs when available
target_value: Ledger entries include req_id field when agent operates on a requirement
notes: When agent works on a requirement (aegis implement REQ-XXX-NNN) the ledger entries carry the req_id. Enables requirement -> evidence traceability.

requirement_text: Agent reads RTMX requirements from .rtmx/database.csv
target_value: Agent can parse and understand requirements from the RTMX corpus
notes: Parse CSV per RTMX schema. Expose as tool: read_requirement(req_id). Agent uses requirements as context for implementation.

requirement_text: Agent updates requirement status and test results
target_value: Agent writes back to .rtmx/database.csv after verification
notes: Update status / test_module / test_function / started_date / completed_date. Requires HITL approval before write. Preserves CSV schema.

requirement_text: Closed-loop verification: requirement -> test -> evidence
target_value: Agent refuses to mark requirement complete without passing tests
notes: aegis verify REQ-XXX-NNN runs linked tests. Pass -> status: COMPLETE + evidence sealed. Fail -> status unchanged + agent enters fix loop.

requirement_text: Test marker scanning for Rust test files
target_value: Agent discovers test-to-requirement links via markers
notes: Scan for #[req(REQ-XXX-NNN)] attribute macros or // @req REQ-XXX-NNN comments. Populate test_module and test_function in CSV.
